jobs.name: controls
keys: eval@upHover:(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('#workshop-lift-up'),s=getComputedStyle(b);if(!b.matches(':hover')||b.disabled||s.backgroundColor!=='rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'||s.borderWidth!=='0px'||s.boxShadow!=='none'||b.textContent)throw new Error('Physical up target has visible DOM decoration or misses real hover');return{hover:b.matches(':hover'),background:s.backgroundColor,border:s.borderWidth,shadow:s.boxShadow};})()

eval@downHover:(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('#workshop-lift-down');if(!b.matches(':hover')||b.disabled)throw new Error('Physical down target misses real hover');return{hover:true,liftHeight:window.__tmtWorkshop.liftHeight};})()

eval@keyboardFocus:(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('#workshop-lift-up');if(document.activeElement!==b||!b.matches(':focus-visible'))throw new Error('Physical control keyboard focus missing');window.__liftBefore=window.__tmtWorkshop.liftHeight;return{focused:true,focusVisible:true};})()

eval@keyboardLift:(()=>{const after=window.__tmtWorkshop.liftHeight;if(after<=window.__liftBefore+.04)throw new Error('Physical keyboard lift did not move');return{before:window.__liftBefore,after};})()
